messages:
max (product): Quick review: finalizing API Keys UX before freeze. Need decisions on empty state, create modal CTA order, secret reveal pattern, and revoke wording.

anya (design): Main asks: primary button must be 'Create key' and visible. For secret reveal, I prefer a compact inline card with prominent short copy: 'Copy now 9 wont be shown again.' Secondary download link visible but less prominent.

devon (devex): Inline card is easiest. Implementation notes: copy-to-clipboard, generate download via JS Blob, and mask secret in DOM after 20s. Provide a checkbox to include sample usage in the .env.

li (eng): Agree with masking and blob. Backend: ensure secret isn't logged and revoke path immediately flips a revoked flag. Staged rollout is out of scope for this release. We'll add last_used column in the API for cleanup UX.

marie (a11y): Accessibility items: announce via aria-live on creation; focus should move into the secret region; copy button aria-label must mention 'will not be shown again'. Revoke dialog must be alertdialog with aria-describedby linking to the warning. Table headers keyboard-focusable with visible focus rings.

anya (design): Empty state variants: 1) Action-first: big CTA 'Create your first key' with 3 use-case chips; 2) First-time demo key (ephemeral) for new orgs. I propose demo for brand-new orgs only, else action-first.

max (product): Demo for new orgs sounds good. Also add a small 'Invite Key Manager' link in empty state to avoid dead-ends. For revoke copy, use: 'Revoking this key may immediately break apps that use it.'

devon (devex): UX nit: show 'Last used' and 'Created' columns on the list. Add a lock icon for restricted keys and only render 'View secret' for users with Key Manager role.

li (eng): We'll gate view-secret server-side and via feature flag. For downloads, avoid putting secret in href attribute; create blob at runtime.

marie (a11y): Also ensure the warning banner contrasts at least 4.5:1 and that the inline secret container has a clear visible focus state.

max (product): Action items: anya update mocks with inline secret and demo-state variant; marie produce a short ARIA checklist and sample attributes; devon write small doc on download blob + TTL masking; li file API ticket for last_used and role gating. I'll track in the sprint board.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch "feature/key-ui-finish" to staging at 2026-03-23T10:30:00Z

max (product): Thanks team!"
